name: geocode
description: OPT-IN geocoding via OSM Nominatim (no key): reverse (`exif --geocode`, gps->place) and forward (address->lat,lng).

entries.label: OSM Nominatim reverse geocoder
entries.summary: OPT-IN geocoding (OSM Nominatim; no key, curl+jq, ~1 req/s usage policy — point OVERCAST_GEOCODE_URL at your own Nominatim/Photon for volume). REVERSE (`exif --geocode`) turns gps->place; FORWARD (`--query "<address>"` / `--forward`) turns an address->{lat,lng,place} (the address->point step for camera-canvass workflows). Egresses the subject's coordinates or address to a third party, so it is never a default.
